articles.title_en: Circular economy intentions in the fruit and vegetable sector of Central Ecuador
articles.title_cn: 厄瓜多尔中部果蔬部门的循环经济意向
articles.abstract_en: The strong dependence on finite resources increases research interest in a circular economy-oriented food system. Building on the theory of planned behavior, this study examines the factors influencing actors in the Ecuadorian fruit and vegetable sector to transition towards a circular economy. Data are collected through an online questionnaire comprising 22 items related to an extension of the theory of planned behavior and 9 organizational characteristics. In total, 306 firms in the fruit and vegetable sector were surveyed. Confirmatory factor analysis and a structural equation model evaluated data fitness and tested the research hypotheses. An analysis of variance tested differences across firm types and chain stages. Results show that the intention to move towards a circular economy is strongly affected by the perceived behavioral control of actors, followed by attitude and social pressure. Although interorganizational coordination is of less influence for behavioral intention, it positively affects actors' perceived control. The results show that beliefs essentially drive circular economy intention. Moreover, large companies put more faith in their own abilities, knowledge and resources, while SMEs rely on the quality of business relationships to participate in a circular economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 对有限资源的强烈依赖增加了对以循环经济为导向的食品系统的研究兴趣。基于计划行为理论，本研究考察了影响厄瓜多尔果蔬部门参与者向循环经济转型的因素。数据通过在线问卷收集，问卷包含与计划行为理论扩展相关的22个项目以及9个组织特征。总共调查了果蔬部门的306家企业。验证性因子分析和结构方程模型评估了数据拟合度并检验了研究假设。方差分析检验了不同企业类型和产业链阶段的差异。结果表明，向循环经济转型的意向受到参与者感知行为控制的强烈影响，其次是态度和社会压力。尽管组织间协调对行为意向的影响较小，但它积极影响参与者的感知控制。结果表明，信念基本上驱动循环经济意向。此外，大型企业更相信自身的能力、知识和资源，而中小企业则依赖商业关系的质量来参与循环经济。

articles.title_en: On the nexus between material and ideological determinants of climate policy support
articles.title_cn: 气候政策支持的物质与意识形态决定因素之间的关系
articles.abstract_en: This study explores how rising economic costs of climate mitigation policies differentially shape climate policy support among the political left and right. To this end, we randomly manipulate how much consumption costs increase as a result of four different climate mitigation policies and study how different cost scenarios influence policy support among a sample of 1,597 Swedish adults. We find that more costly climate policies induce greater climate policy polarization, since right-leaning participants display both lower baseline and more cost-sensitive climate policy support. In addition, we investigate how policy costs affect participants’ concerns about the climatic consequences of consumption. While inconclusive, the results indicate that right-leaning participants, in some instances, display less concern about the climatic consequences of consumption when policy costs rise. This pattern can be understood through the lens of motivated disbelief, which holds that people adjust their beliefs in order to support their preferred actions. The present study provides novel insights as to how and when material conditions influence climate policy preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了气候减缓政策的经济成本上升如何在不同政治立场的人群中差异化地影响气候政策支持。为此，我们随机操纵了四种不同气候减缓政策导致的消费成本增加幅度，并研究了不同成本情景如何影响一项包含1,597名瑞典成年人的样本中的政策支持。我们发现，成本更高的气候政策会加剧气候政策的两极分化，因为右倾参与者的基线支持率较低，且其支持对成本更为敏感。此外，我们调查了政策成本如何影响参与者对消费气候后果的担忧。尽管结果不确定，但表明在某些情况下，当政策成本上升时，右倾参与者对消费气候后果的担忧较少。这一模式可以通过动机性否认的视角来理解，即人们调整自己的信念以支持其偏好的行为。本研究为物质条件如何以及何时影响气候政策偏好提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: The value of information in water quality monitoring and management
articles.title_cn: 水质监测与管理中信息的价值
articles.abstract_en: Environmental managers face substantial uncertainty when deciding on management actions. To reduce this uncertainty prior to decision-making, collecting new data may help arrive at more informed decisions. Whether any resulting improvement in the decision will outweigh the cost of collecting the data, and thus make investing in the acquisition of the information worthwhile, is an intricate question. The concept of the value of information (VoI) is a convenient tool to address this problem. We use the VoI framework to analyse a decision problem in water quality management. Based on real-world monitoring data, we calculate the VoI of monitoring nitrogen, which is used as an indicator of the ecological state of water body. We find that the VoI is significant in our case and we further investigate the dependency of the VoI in a similar setting on the management cost, the assumed value of a good state and on the level of uncertainty regarding the ecological state. In addition, we observe a negative relation between the relative management cost and the prior probability that maximises VoI. These insights may help decide on information acquisition in the presence of substantial uncertainties and sparse data.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境管理者在决定管理行动时面临巨大的不确定性。为了在决策前减少这种不确定性，收集新数据可能有助于做出更明智的决策。由此产生的决策改进是否能超过数据收集的成本，从而使信息获取的投资值得进行，这是一个复杂的问题。信息价值（VoI）的概念是解决这一问题的便捷工具。我们使用VoI框架分析水质管理中的一个决策问题。基于实际监测数据，我们计算了作为水体生态状态指标的氮监测的VoI。我们发现，在我们的案例中，VoI是显著的，并进一步研究了类似情境下VoI对管理成本、良好状态假定价值以及生态状态不确定性水平的依赖性。此外，我们观察到相对管理成本与使VoI最大化的先验概率之间存在负相关关系。这些见解可能有助于在存在重大不确定性和数据稀疏的情况下决定信息获取。

articles.title_en: Renewing the Subterranean Energy Regime? How Petroculture Obscures the Materiality of Deep Geothermal Energy Technology in Sweden
articles.title_cn: 更新地下能源体系？石油文化如何掩盖瑞典深层地热能技术的物质性
articles.abstract_en: Social visions to replace fossil fuels with renewable energy sources have motivated unprecedented growth in global renewable energy manufacturing. Previous literature shows that people committed to realizing such visions have difficulties reconciling with the negative social-ecological impacts of this mass production even if it presents a formidable challenge to a socially just and ecologically sustainable energy transition. This study contributes to a better understanding of how stakeholders view the promises and perils of large-scale renewable energy development. It draws on the petroculure literature to understand how stakeholder viewpoints of deep geothermal energy technology may be a product of the historically unparalleled energy throughput since the mid-20th century. The study relies on Q-methodology for identifying viewpoints among stakeholders in deep geothermal energy in Sweden. The results demonstrate a notable influence of petrocultural assumptions, which helps to explain how stakeholders obfuscate the materiality of renewable energy technologies. This suggests that social visions to replace fossil fuels with technologically sophisticated renewable energy systems could themselves be cultural products of the fossil era inclined to reproduce it.
articles.abstract_cn: 以可再生能源替代化石燃料的社会愿景推动了全球可再生能源制造业的空前增长。既有文献表明，致力于实现此类愿景的人们难以调和这种大规模生产所带来的负面社会生态影响，即使这对实现社会公正和生态可持续的能源转型构成了严峻挑战。本研究有助于更好地理解利益相关者如何看待大规模可再生能源开发的承诺与风险。它借鉴石油文化文献，以理解利益相关者对深层地热能技术的看法如何可能是自20世纪中叶以来历史上前所未有的能源吞吐量的产物。本研究采用Q方法论来识别瑞典深层地热能利益相关者的观点。结果表明，石油文化假设具有显著影响，这有助于解释利益相关者如何掩盖可再生能源技术的物质性。这表明，以技术复杂的可再生能源系统替代化石燃料的社会愿景本身可能就是化石时代的文化产物，并倾向于复制这一时代。

articles.title_en: Are there gender differences in household carbon footprints? Evidence from Spain
articles.title_cn: 家庭碳足迹是否存在性别差异？来自西班牙的证据
articles.abstract_en: Identifying the main drivers of the household carbon footprint (HCF) is a priority to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and move towards a more sustainable economy. Among the multiple factors that explain the HCF, some previous research has confirmed the relevance of gender. In this paper, we calculate the HCF of individual Spanish households using an environmentally extended multi-regional input-output model (EEMRIO) that quantifies the emissions embedded in the supply chain of goods and services that households consume. We assess the differences in consumption and emissions patterns, measuring the gender effect by a new variable, the female share of the household. This represents a remarkable improvement over previous literature that used simpler approaches. Moreover, we assess the partial effect of gender on HCF using multivariate regressions for total and sectoral emissions. Our results show that households with a majority of men have a higher HCF and carbon intensity. Even when controlling for economic, sociodemographic, and regional factors there are differences in the sectoral emissions according to gender. Female households spend more (and generate more emissions) on housing and food products, while male households show that pattern for restaurants and transport. These results can help orientate environmental campaigns and demand-side mitigation policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 识别家庭碳足迹（HCF）的主要驱动因素是减少温室气体排放、迈向更可持续经济的优先事项。在解释HCF的众多因素中，一些先前研究已确认了性别的重要性。本文使用环境扩展的多区域投入产出模型（EEMRIO）计算西班牙个体家庭的家庭碳足迹，该模型量化了家庭消费的商品和服务供应链中嵌入的排放。我们通过一个新变量——家庭中女性占比，来评估消费和排放模式的差异，衡量性别效应。这比先前使用更简单方法的文献有了显著改进。此外，我们使用多元回归评估性别对总排放和部门排放的部分效应。结果表明，男性占多数的家庭具有更高的HCF和碳强度。即使在控制经济、社会人口和区域因素后，部门排放仍存在性别差异。女性家庭在住房和食品上的支出更多（并产生更多排放），而男性家庭则在餐馆和交通方面表现出这种模式。这些结果有助于指导环境运动和需求侧减缓政策。

articles.title_en: Karl Polanyi's and K. William Kapp's arguments on social costs: is there a common “revolutionary” raison d'être?
articles.title_cn: 卡尔·波兰尼与K.威廉·卡普关于社会成本的论证：是否存在共同的“革命性”存在理由？
articles.abstract_en: This article examines Karl Polanyi’s and K. William Kapp’s social cost proposals to test their suitability for a “revolutionary” Social Ecological Economics that radically breaks with neoclassical and neoliberal paradigms. Whilst some coherence is revealed in their revolutionary social cost analyses and solutions, this is much messier than previously thought. This messiness is partly due to their different adoptions and reactions to neoclassical and neoliberal arguments and partly due to differences in four key dimensions of social costs: simple vs. system-wide effects, local vs. central solutions, payment vs. prevention strategies, and monetary accounting vs. physical calculation. The coherence in their raison d'être is through 1) the prevention of social costs to secure social provisioning of human needs; 2) a social valuation of lexicographically ordered physical and monetary quantification of social costs; and 3) a qualitative measure as the ultimate concern, that is “social justice” of “Dasein” as a “humanitarian ideal” (Polanyi) and human “dignity” as a qualitative “measure of all things” (Kapp). This reflects their disagreement with neoclassical and neoliberal paradigms through their rejection of monetary economizing as the exclusive definition of the “economy” and for dealing with social costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察卡尔·波兰尼和K.威廉·卡普的社会成本主张，以检验其是否适合作为一种“革命性”的社会生态经济学，该经济学从根本上与新古典和新自由主义范式决裂。尽管在他们的革命性社会成本分析和解决方案中显示出某种一致性，但这比先前认为的要混乱得多。这种混乱部分源于他们对新古典和新自由主义论点的不同采纳和反应，部分源于社会成本四个关键维度的差异：简单效应与系统范围效应、地方性解决方案与中央解决方案、支付策略与预防策略，以及货币核算与实物计算。他们存在理由的一致性在于：1预防社会成本以确保人类需求的社会供给；2对社会成本进行词典序排列的实物和货币量化的社会评价；以及3作为最终关注的定性衡量，即作为“人道主义理想”的“此在”的“社会正义”（波兰尼）和作为“万物尺度”的定性“人的尊严”（卡普）。这反映了他们与新古典和新自由主义范式的分歧，即拒绝将货币节约作为“经济”的唯一定义以及处理社会成本的唯一方式。

articles.title_en: What if Brazilians reduce their beef consumption?
articles.title_cn: 如果巴西人减少牛肉消费怎么办？
articles.abstract_en: Beef, among all foods, has the greatest environmental impact and is associated with several chronic diseases. Brazil is one of the largest consumers of meat in the world, on par with developed countries and, most of its greenhouse gas emissions stem from deforestation and agricultural activities. Therefore, this article aims to project the economic and environmental impacts of reducing beef consumption due to changes in household preferences and an increase in beef taxes, with and without a revenue neutral mechanism (subsidies applied to food, excluding meat). To analyze this, a dynamic interregional Computable General Equilibrium model was employed, incorporating a land use change module and accounting for substitution between different food items in both consumption and production structure across regions within the Brazilian Amazon, Matopiba, and the rest of Brazil. The results show that a 40% reduction in beef consumption distributed between 2022 and 2050 could prevent deforestation on an area of approximately 65,000 km2, potentially mitigating up to 2.8 GtCO₂e (a third of the world's potential mitigation from dietary changes according to the UN). In the scenario with subsidies, the reduction in deforestation is smaller due to incentives provided to certain commodities that use pasture. Preference changes could have a virtually zero impact on GDP by 2050. Conversely, increased beef taxes could result in an overall rise in costs, leading to a negative impact on exports and GDP (subsidies only attenuate). In all scenarios, regional impacts would be heterogeneous, particularly affecting regions highly dependent on the cattle and beef sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 在所有食物中，牛肉对环境的影响最大，并且与多种慢性疾病有关。巴西是世界上最大的肉类消费国之一，与发达国家相当，其大部分温室气体排放来自森林砍伐和农业活动。因此，本文旨在预测在有或没有收入中性机制（对食品（不包括肉类）进行补贴）的情况下，由于家庭偏好的变化和牛肉税的增加而减少牛肉消费的经济和环境影响。为了分析这一点，采用了动态区域间可计算一般均衡模型，纳入了土地利用变化模块，并考虑了巴西亚马逊、马托皮巴和巴西其他地区各地区消费和生产结构中不同食品之间的替代。结果表明，2022 和 2050 之间牛肉消费量的 40% 减少可以防止约 65,000 km2 区域的森林砍伐，从而可能减少高达 2.8 GtCO2e（根据联合国的数据，全球饮食变化可能减少的三分之一）。在有补贴的情况下，由于对某些使用牧场的商品提供了激励，森林砍伐的减少幅度较小。到2050，偏好变化对 GDP 的影响几乎为零。相反，增加牛肉税可能会导致成本总体上升，从而对出口和 GDP 产生负面影响（补贴只会减弱）。在所有情况下，区域影响都是不同的，特别是影响高度依赖牛和牛肉行业的区域。

articles.title_en: Economic, environmental, and energy equity convergence: Evidence of a multi-speed Europe?
articles.title_cn: 经济、环境与能源公平的趋同：多速欧洲的证据？
articles.abstract_en: The EU has committed to make Europe the first climate-neutral continent by 2050. Reaching this objective requires massive changes in the region. The biggest challenge is that the green transition happens without sacrificing economic progress and guaranteeing justice and inclusiveness. This pledge implies that every country be capable of addressing the trade-offs between targets while remaining committed towards the common decarbonisation goal. Our paper analyses the success with which countries are carrying out the energy transition. We propose an enhanced hyperbolic distance function and a stochastic frontier analysis approach to model the joint attainment of economic development, environmental sustainability, and energy equity. We apply our model to an unbalanced panel dataset of 29 European countries for the period 2005–2018. Our estimates show that the average performance of the economies has improved over time. The results also highlight the pivotal role of a sustainable economic development with clean energies for both slashing CO2 emissions and fostering energy equity. Moreover, we find convergence in countries' performance, being this convergence slightly higher for the EU-15 countries compared to the rest. Finally, we show that a higher share of renewable energy sources helps countries that are lagging behind to reach their optimal performance level.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟已承诺到2050年使欧洲成为首个气候中和大陆。实现这一目标需要该地区发生巨大变化。最大的挑战在于绿色转型在不牺牲经济进步并保障公正与包容的前提下进行。这一承诺意味着每个国家都必须有能力在目标之间权衡取舍，同时继续致力于共同的脱碳目标。本文分析了各国在能源转型方面的成功程度。我们提出了一种增强的双曲距离函数和随机前沿分析方法，以模拟经济发展、环境可持续性和能源公平的联合实现。我们将模型应用于2005-2018年间29个欧洲国家的不平衡面板数据集。我们的估计显示，各经济体的平均绩效随时间有所改善。结果还强调了以清洁能源实现可持续经济发展对于减少CO2排放和促进能源公平的关键作用。此外，我们发现各国绩效存在趋同，且欧盟15国之间的趋同程度略高于其他国家。最后，我们表明，可再生能源占比越高，有助于落后国家达到其最优绩效水平。

articles.title_en: The Role of Voluntary Environmental Policies Towards Achieving Circularity
articles.title_cn: 自愿性环境政策在实现循环经济中的作用
articles.abstract_en: Over the last decade, waste management and prevention have become important in the transition towards a circular economy (CE). This study explores how voluntary environmental policies, adopted at a regional level, contribute to green transition from the perspective of the CE. By considering general and region-specific trends in waste management and environmental certifications, we perform a two-step analysis on a panel of 20 Italian regions between 2015 and 2019: the first step extrapolates the relative efficiency by using a Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA), while the second step extrapolates the efficiency in terms of productivity changes supported by Malmquist Productivity Analysis (MPA). The DEA results show an overall rising trend of efficiency among the Italian regions, supported by the MPA. Furthermore, they reveal that technological innovation in Italian waste management contributes to a greater efficiency in socio-economic systems which are characterized by ‘environmental federalism’. From a decision-making perspective, this study suggests that measures such as the incentivization of voluntary environmental policies should be proposed to promote techno-organizations' transition to CE, in coherence with regional economic/industrial specializations and strategies, possibly based on a diversified policy mix, setting a knowledge-based framework by using budgetary measures and policy actions at the regional level.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去十年中，废物管理和预防已成为向循环经济（CE）转型的重要环节。本研究探讨了在区域层面采用的自愿性环境政策如何从循环经济的视角促进绿色转型。通过考虑废物管理和环境认证中的一般趋势和区域特定趋势，我们对2015年至2019年间意大利20个地区的小组数据进行了两步分析：第一步使用数据包络分析（DEA）推断相对效率，第二步使用Malmquist生产率分析（MPA）推断生产率变化方面的效率。DEA结果显示意大利各地区的效率总体呈上升趋势，MPA也支持这一结论。此外，结果还表明，意大利废物管理中的技术创新有助于在具有“环境联邦主义”特征的社会经济系统中实现更高的效率。从决策角度来看，本研究建议，应提出激励自愿性环境政策等措施，以促进技术组织向循环经济转型，并与区域经济/产业专业化和战略保持一致，可能基于多元化的政策组合，通过使用预算措施和区域层面的政策行动来建立基于知识的框架。

articles.title_en: Investing in Nature: Assessing the Effects of Monetary and Non-Monetary Valuations on Decision-Making
articles.title_cn: 投资自然：评估货币与非货币估值对决策的影响
articles.abstract_en: There is widespread debate over how best to consider and integrate nature's diverse value dimensions into decision-making over natural resources. Following an experimental approach, this study tests the impact of a monetary versus non-monetary framing on conservation preferences relating to (hypothetical) mountain and wetland sites in the Basque Country (Spain). The experiment also examines whether these framings evoke different levels of cognitive and experiential reasoning. The experiment was conducted online and had 305 participants from the Basque Country. Findings show that while participants believed non-monetary information (i) better reflects the value of nature, (ii) is more useful than monetary information for environmental decision-making, and (iii) scored it higher in terms of whether the information provided was sufficient to make an informed decision, monetary valuation had a greater pull in determining the actual allocation of the conservation budget. This result has important consequences as it demonstrates that exposure to different forms of information may unwittingly have a significant impact on decision-makers' judgement in management and policy decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于如何最好地考虑和整合自然的多元价值维度到自然资源决策中，存在广泛争论。本研究采用实验方法，测试了货币与非货币框架对与西班牙巴斯克地区（假想的）山地和湿地遗址保护偏好的影响。实验还考察了这些框架是否引发不同水平的认知和体验推理。实验在线进行，共有305名来自巴斯克地区的参与者。研究结果表明，尽管参与者认为非货币信息（i）更能反映自然的价值，（ii）在环境决策中比货币信息更有用，并且（iii）在提供的信息是否足以做出明智决策方面给予其更高评分，但货币估值在决定实际保护预算分配方面具有更大的影响力。这一结果具有重要意义，因为它表明接触不同形式的信息可能无意中对决策者在管理和政策决策中的判断产生显著影响。

articles.title_en: Leverage points for sustainability transformation: Identifying past and future changes in the Finnish (circular) plastic packing system
articles.title_cn: 可持续转型的杠杆点：识别芬兰（循环）塑料包装系统中的过去与未来变化
articles.abstract_en: The circular economy is hailed in the policymaking and industrial communities as a key solution to reduce material and energy throughput in our economic system, The “leverage points” concept helps to understand how sustainability transformations can be accelerated. Leverage points are places to intervene in a system. The concept postulates that transformative change is unlikely if only shallow leverage points are acted upon, while recognizing that intervening at deep leverage points is difficult in practice, even if the benefits might be substantial. This article refines the leverage points concept and applies it to the circular economy, exploring the mechanisms for transformative change. First, we examined what kind of leverage points have been identified in scientific literature in general and how they are said to introduce changes in the system. Second, we examined what kind of leverage points towards circularity were identified in the Finnish plastic packing system through a collaborative workshop with practitioners. Our results show that such leverage points vary from concrete ones at the parameter level (e.g., incentives, regulations), societal ones at the design level (e.g., increased collaboration at industry level, reformulation of company strategies) to abstract ones towards the system intent (e.g., renewed environmental values, changing ways of thinking). Regarding the packaging system, practitioners found it easier to think within existing structures rather than to come up with disruptive amendments. Thus, leverage point research requires creative thinking that challenges both stakeholders' and scientists' worldviews.
articles.abstract_cn: 循环经济在政策制定和工业界被誉为减少经济系统中物质和能源吞吐量的关键解决方案，“杠杆点”概念有助于理解如何加速可持续转型。杠杆点是系统中可以进行干预的地方。该概念假设，如果只作用于浅层杠杆点，转型性变革不太可能发生，同时认识到在深层杠杆点进行干预在实践中是困难的，即使收益可能很大。本文细化了杠杆点概念并将其应用于循环经济，探索转型性变革的机制。首先，我们考察了科学文献中普遍识别出的杠杆点类型，以及它们如何被认为引入系统变化。其次，我们通过与从业者的合作研讨会，考察了芬兰塑料包装系统中识别出的朝向循环性的杠杆点类型。我们的结果表明，这些杠杆点从参数层面的具体点（例如，激励措施、法规），到设计层面的社会性点（例如，行业层面加强合作、公司战略重新制定），再到朝向系统意图的抽象点（例如，更新环境价值观、改变思维方式）。关于包装系统，从业者发现更容易在现有结构内思考，而不是提出颠覆性的修正。因此，杠杆点研究需要创造性思维，挑战利益相关者和科学家的世界观。

articles.title_en: Gender equality and sustainable development: A cross-country study on women's contribution to the adoption of the climate-smart agriculture in Sub-Saharan Africa
articles.title_cn: 性别平等与可持续发展：撒哈拉以南非洲女性对气候智能型农业采用贡献的跨国研究
articles.abstract_en: Women face severe gender-specific constraints and have minimal part in the farm decision-making systems in sub-Saharan Africa. This leads to additional barriers in the adoption of climate-smart agriculture (CSA) technologies. This paper contributes to the gender debate by focusing on intra-household gender dynamics that influence the adaptive capacities of small-holder farmers. Using a multi-country approach, and considering Ethiopia, Malawi, South Africa, and Tanzania as case studies, an endogenous-switching poisson regression model was conducted to (i) assess factors influencing the probability of women's engagement in agricultural technology decision-making; (ii) ascertain the effect of women's participation in farm decision-making on climate-smart agriculture adoption. The findings indicate a degree of complexity in women's roles within their communities and family contexts. While in Malawi women participating in the farm decision-making process positively affects CSA adoption, in the other countries their role remains marginal or negatively related with farm sustainability. Such women's empowerment is indeed influenced by the existence of social, regulatory, and cultural elements that uniquely define the considered countries. Context-specific policies that prioritize rural-women, youths, and other marginalized groups can enhance CSA adoption and thereby contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals such as gender equality, climate action and zero hunger in developing contexts.
articles.abstract_cn: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，女性面临严重的性别特定限制，并且在农场决策系统中参与度极低。这导致在采用气候智能型农业（CSA）技术方面存在额外障碍。本文通过关注影响小农户适应能力的家庭内部性别动态，为性别辩论做出贡献。采用多国方法，并以埃塞俄比亚、马拉维、南非和坦桑尼亚为案例研究，进行了内生转换泊松回归模型，以（i）评估影响女性参与农业技术决策概率的因素；（ii）确定女性参与农场决策对气候智能型农业采用的影响。研究结果表明，女性在社区和家庭背景中的角色具有一定复杂性。在马拉维，参与农场决策过程的女性对CSA采用有积极影响，而在其他国家，她们的角色仍然边缘化或与农场可持续性负相关。这种女性赋权确实受到社会、监管和文化元素的影响，这些元素独特地定义了所考虑的国家。针对具体情况、优先考虑农村女性、青年和其他边缘化群体的政策可以增强CSA采用，从而有助于实现可持续发展目标，如性别平等、气候行动和发展中背景下的零饥饿。

articles.title_en: Rising from the ashes: Transitioning towards carbon neutrality through the pathways of circular economy agglomeration
articles.title_cn: 浴火重生：通过循环经济集聚路径迈向碳中和
articles.abstract_en: The study investigates the transition of circular economy (CE) implementation from individual enterprises to CE agglomeration in industrial parks and at regional levels, with a focus on its potential for driving innovation towards achieving carbon neutrality. Measurement of CE agglomeration is generated from annual firm registration records from 2010 to 2015. For city-level carbon emissions, China High-Resolution Emission Database (CHRED) from 2015 to 2019 is used. Then, structural equation modeling with a propensity score matching is employed to validate our theoretical model for the CE agglomeration pathway and its impact on city-level carbon emissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了循环经济（CE）实施从个体企业向工业园区和区域层面的循环经济集聚转变，重点关注其推动创新以实现碳中和的潜力。循环经济集聚的衡量基于2010年至2015年的年度企业注册记录。对于城市级碳排放，使用了2015年至2019年的中国高分辨率排放数据库（CHRED）。然后，采用倾向得分匹配的结构方程模型来验证我们关于循环经济集聚路径及其对城市级碳排放影响的理论模型。

articles.title_en: Ecosystem complementarities: Evidence from over 700 U.S. watersheds
articles.title_cn: 生态系统互补性：来自美国超过700个流域的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates how the slope of a production possibilities frontier (PPF) can be used to empirically identify the presence of an ecosystem externality. Complementarity between non-market ecosystem services implies the PPF between these services may be upward sloping. In contrast, private landowners that ignore these complementarities will treat non-market ecosystem services as competing products thereby ensuring a downward sloping PPF. Using data from 738 U.S. watersheds, we compare the slope of PPFs on predominately private and predominately public watersheds. We find evidence that private markets are failing to internalize complementarities between forest habitat and two other non-market ecosystem services: instream flows and grazing. In addition, we show how three-stage least squares regression can be used to reduce endogeneity bias associated with more common approaches to estimating ecosystem service relationships.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文展示了如何利用生产可能性边界（PPF）的斜率来实证识别生态系统外部性的存在。非市场生态系统服务之间的互补性意味着这些服务之间的PPF可能是向上倾斜的。相反，忽视这些互补性的私人土地所有者会将非市场生态系统服务视为竞争性产品，从而确保PPF向下倾斜。利用美国738个流域的数据，我们比较了以私人为主的流域和以公共为主的流域的PPF斜率。我们发现证据表明，私人市场未能将森林栖息地与另外两种非市场生态系统服务——河道内流量和放牧——之间的互补性内部化。此外，我们展示了如何使用三阶段最小二乘回归来减少与估计生态系统服务关系的更常见方法相关的内生性偏差。

articles.title_en: Turtle Economic Value: The non-use value of marine turtles in the Asia-Pacific region
articles.title_cn: 海龟的经济价值：亚太地区海龟的非使用价值
articles.abstract_en: Marine turtle species in the Asia-Pacific region face loss of habitat, population decline and serious risk of extinction. Understanding the associated loss in human welfare can motivate conservation finance, policy reforms and other actions to protect and restore marine turtle populations. This paper estimates non-use values for marine turtles in the Asia-Pacific region using a large-sample (n = 7765) global household survey. The survey focused on six countries in the region (China, Fiji, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines and Vietnam) but received responses from over 80 countries in total. A discrete choice experiment was used to elicit willingness-to-pay (WTP) for marine turtles, defined in terms of population trends (increasing, stable or declining) and species diversity (avoided extinctions). We find that a high proportion of households (82%) expressed a positive WTP for turtle conservation, and that the donation amounts are substantial. The median WTP for ensuring stable marine turtle populations, adjusted for demographic differences between the survey sample and the general population, is estimated at US $79 per household per year. A scenario analysis is used to estimate the economic welfare changes that would result from policy inaction (in which turtle populations continue to decline and two species become extinct) versus strong policy action (resulting in increasing turtle populations and no extinctions). The welfare loss that results from not acting is estimated to be US $40 billion per year, whereas the potential welfare gain from taking policy action to conserve, manage and protect marine turtles is estimated at US $55 billion per year. These results present a strong economic justification for governments across the region to align their environmental policies and budgets with Asia-Pacific peoples' stated WTP for turtle conservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 亚太地区的海龟物种面临栖息地丧失、种群数量下降和严重灭绝风险。理解相关的人类福利损失可以激励保护融资、政策改革和其他行动，以保护和恢复海龟种群。本文使用大样本（n = 7765）的全球家庭调查，估计了亚太地区海龟的非使用价值。该调查聚焦于该地区的六个国家（中国、斐济、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾和越南），但总共收到了来自超过80个国家的回复。采用离散选择实验来引出对海龟的支付意愿（WTP），以种群趋势（增加、稳定或下降）和物种多样性（避免灭绝）来定义。我们发现，高比例的家庭（82%）对海龟保护表达了积极的支付意愿，且捐赠金额可观。在调整了调查样本与一般人口之间的人口统计学差异后，确保海龟种群稳定的中位数支付意愿估计为每户每年79美元。使用情景分析来估计政策不作为（海龟种群持续下降，两个物种灭绝）与强力政策行动（海龟种群增加，无灭绝）所导致的经济福利变化。不作为导致的福利损失估计为每年40亿美元，而采取政策行动保护、管理和保护海龟的潜在福利收益估计为每年55亿美元。这些结果为该地区各国政府将其环境政策和预算与亚太人民对海龟保护的明确支付意愿保持一致提供了强有力的经济理由。

articles.title_en: Comparing Australian public and farmer views on agricultural land use and management practices for sustainability
articles.title_cn: 比较澳大利亚公众与农民对农业土地利用和管理实践可持续性的看法
articles.abstract_en: Using a survey of the public (n = 2032) and broadacre farmers (n = 351) in South Australia and Victoria, Australia, this research compares public and farmers' concerns regarding the acceptability and sustainability of agricultural operations. A principal component analysis was conducted on survey responses to 15 statements capturing environmental, social and governance issues related to agriculture practices and perceptions. This analysis revealed three dimensions: (1) issues related to animal welfare, greenhouse gas emissions and food safety; (2) issues related to farm input use; and (3) the use of socially valuable assets for private profits. Compared to farmers, the public were more concerned about the undersupply of public goods (e.g., farm animal welfare), and issues related to farm input use such as the use of synthetic fertilisers and chemicals. The public and farmers reported a similar level of concern regarding the use of socially valuable assets for private profit (e.g., irrigation water extraction). Regression analyses revealed associations between concerns and socio-demographic characteristics; environmental attitudes; sources of information; and farm characteristics. This study can act as a catalyst for developing practical strategies to analyse and overcome the issues, rather than symptoms, of concern affecting the agricultural industry and its sustainability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用对澳大利亚南澳大利亚州和维多利亚州公众（n = 2032）和粗放型农民（n = 351）的调查，比较了公众和农民对农业经营可接受性和可持续性的关注。对调查中关于农业实践和感知的环境、社会和治理问题的15项陈述进行了主成分分析。该分析揭示了三个维度：（1）与动物福利、温室气体排放和食品安全相关的问题；（2）与农场投入品使用相关的问题；（3）将社会有价值的资产用于私人利润。与农民相比，公众更关注公共物品的供应不足（例如，农场动物福利），以及与农场投入品使用相关的问题，如合成肥料和化学品的使用。公众和农民对将社会有价值的资产用于私人利润（例如，灌溉水提取）的关注程度相似。回归分析揭示了关注与社会人口特征、环境态度、信息来源和农场特征之间的关联。本研究可作为制定实际策略的催化剂，以分析和克服影响农业及其可持续性的问题，而非症状。

articles.title_en: Assessing the impact of agri-environmental payments on green productivity in Germany
articles.title_cn: 评估德国农业环境支付对绿色生产率的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study offers a novel empirical application for assessing the impact of agri-environment schemes (AES) on the performance of farms. The existing evidence about the impact of these schemes considering environmental and economic aspects equally is still limited. Therefore, our objective is to contribute to the literature on the impact evaluation of AES by considering three important aspects in our empirical analysis. First, the performance of farms is proxied by an indicator that incorporates environmental externalities into production activities. Second, our empirical analysis focuses on a sample of Bavarian dairy farms covering the period 2013–2018, thus, we can evaluate the effectiveness of agri-environmental schemes in one of Germany's leading agricultural and forestry regions during the latest programming period. Finally, in an effort to increase robustness, we employ an improved version of the Malmquist-Luenberger productivity index, which enables us to get around some of the shortcomings of the original index. The obtained results suggest that agri-environment payments have a limited effect on improving farm-level green productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了一种新颖的实证应用，用于评估农业环境计划（AES）对农场绩效的影响。现有关于这些计划同时考虑环境和经济方面影响的证据仍然有限。因此，我们的目标是通过在实证分析中考虑三个重要方面，为AES影响评估的文献做出贡献。首先，农场绩效通过一个将环境外部性纳入生产活动的指标来代理。其次，我们的实证分析聚焦于巴伐利亚奶牛场样本，覆盖2013-2018年期间，因此，我们可以评估在最新规划期内，农业环境计划在德国领先的农业和林业地区之一的有效性。最后，为了增强稳健性，我们采用了改进版的Malmquist-Luenberger生产率指数，这使我们能够绕过原始指数的一些缺陷。所得结果表明，农业环境支付对提高农场层面绿色生产率的影响有限。

articles.title_en: Incentives for biodiversity conservation under asymmetric land ownership
articles.title_cn: 土地所有权不对称下的生物多样性保护激励
articles.abstract_en: The effectiveness of biodiversity conservation initiatives depends on their ability to maintain and restore the integrity and connectivity of ecological systems. Payments for environmental services (PES) can encourage farmers to set aside land for conservation, but landscape connectivity requires coordination among land users. Fairness in the distribution of payoffs has been shown to affect conservation efforts in response to PES, but the sources of inequality in payment allocation mechanisms can be manifold. Here we focus on the performance of conservation incentives under alternative payment modalities and levels of inequality in land ownership. We applied lab-in-the-field experiment with 384 Tanzanian farmers from two ecological corridors. Groups of participants were endowed with either equal or unequal amounts of hypothetical farmland and subsequently exposed to two treatments, namely a fixed individual payment and a fixed payment with an agglomeration bonus. Both payment modalities had positive effects on conservation, but we find no strong evidence for impact of asymmetries in landownership on conservation decisions. Overall, our results suggest that conditional payments can be effective even when land with high conservation value is unequally distributed in ecological corridors.
articles.abstract_cn: 生物多样性保护举措的有效性取决于其维持和恢复生态系统完整性与连通性的能力。环境服务付费（PES）可以鼓励农民留出土地用于保护，但景观连通性需要土地使用者之间的协调。支付分配的公平性已被证明会影响对PES的保护努力，但支付分配机制中不平等的来源可能是多方面的。在此，我们关注在不同支付模式和土地所有权不平等水平下保护激励的表现。我们对来自两个生态走廊的384名坦桑尼亚农民进行了实地实验。参与者小组被赋予相等或不相等的假设农田数量，随后接受两种处理，即固定个人支付和带有集聚奖金的固定支付。两种支付模式对保护都有积极影响，但我们没有发现强有力的证据表明土地所有权的不对称性对保护决策有影响。总体而言，我们的结果表明，即使高保护价值土地在生态走廊中分配不均，有条件支付也能有效。

articles.title_en: The development of bio-based industry in the European Union: A prospective integrated modelling assessment
articles.title_cn: 欧盟生物基产业的发展：一项前瞻性综合建模评估
articles.abstract_en: Quantitative bioeconomy simulation models aid our understanding of the complex market driven dynamics accompanying the transition to a net-zero economy. This research addresses knowledge gaps in EU bioeconomy modelling capacity, particularly representations of contemporary bio-based industrial markets. Encompassing a comprehensive selection of biomass types and bioeconomy activities, an integrated model toolbox is constructed consisting of five state-of-the-art bioeconomy simulation models. Focusing on a public-policy driven bio-based industrial transformation, exploratory scenarios examine the synergies and trade-offs for the EU through the prism of its five bioeconomy pillars. Results indicate that the promotion of biomass for industry reduces fossil dependence, although if enacted globally, may result in a substantial increase in biomass demand. In addition, carbon taxes further accelerate market opportunities for bio-based alternatives, although a bio-based industry transformation contingent, at least in part, on woody and agricultural biomass feedstocks, will not achieve important reductions in emissions. Finally, in addition to a strict adherence to the principle of circularity in biomass usage, a socially responsible change in consumption behaviour represents an essential strategy for easing (agricultural) biomass market tensions.
articles.abstract_cn: 定量生物经济模拟模型有助于我们理解向净零经济转型过程中伴随的复杂市场驱动动态。本研究解决了欧盟生物经济建模能力方面的知识空白，特别是对当代生物基工业市场的表征。涵盖生物质类型和生物经济活动的全面选择，构建了一个由五个最先进的生物经济模拟模型组成的综合模型工具箱。聚焦于公共政策驱动的生物基工业转型，探索性情景通过其五大生物经济支柱的视角审视欧盟的协同效应与权衡。结果表明，推广生物质用于工业可减少化石依赖，尽管若在全球范围内实施，可能导致生物质需求大幅增加。此外，碳税进一步加速了生物基替代品的市场机会，尽管生物基工业转型至少部分依赖于木质和农业生物质原料，将无法实现重要的减排。最后，除了严格遵守生物质利用的循环性原则外，社会负责任的消费行为变化是缓解（农业）生物质市场紧张的关键策略。

articles.title_en: Remaining Loyal to Our Soil: A Prospective Integrated Assessment of Soil Erosion on Global Food Security
articles.title_cn: 坚守我们的土壤：水土流失对全球粮食安全的前瞻性综合评估
articles.abstract_en: Soil loss by water erosion represents a key threat to land degradation worldwide. This study employs an integrated quantitative modelling approach to estimate its long-term global sustainability impacts. The global biophysical model estimates a mean increase of soil erosion rates of between 30 and 66% over the period 2015–2070 under alternative climate-economic scenarios, assuming different greenhouse gas concentration trajectories. In a subsequent step, projected soil erosion rates are converted into land productivity losses and inputted into an economic global simulation model to identify those regional hotspots where the greatest market tensions are expected to occur.
articles.abstract_cn: 水蚀造成的土壤流失是全球土地退化的主要威胁。本研究采用综合定量建模方法，估算其长期全球可持续性影响。全球生物物理模型估计，在替代气候经济情景下，假设不同的温室气体浓度轨迹，30-66%年期间土壤侵蚀速率的平均增幅在2015至2070之间。在后续步骤中，预测的土壤侵蚀速率被转化为土地生产力损失，并输入全球经济模拟模型，以识别预计将出现最大市场紧张的区域热点。

articles.title_en: How does environmental regulation promote green technology innovation? Evidence from China's total emission control policy
articles.title_cn: 环境规制如何促进绿色技术创新？来自中国总量控制政策的证据
articles.abstract_en: Whether environmental regulation incentivizes green technology innovations is debated in the literature. The potential endogeneity of environmental regulation is the major empirical challenge for identifying the causal effect of environmental regulation on green technology innovations. To address this issue, we use the quasi-natural experiment of China's Total Emission Control Policy as exogenous shocks of environmental regulation. Specifically, we construct a new dataset of the city-level emission reduction mandates and employ the difference-in-difference-in-differences estimation to explore how stringency of environmental regulation affects green technology innovations. The empirical results show that environmental regulation promotes green innovations. Further mechanism analysis shows environmental regulation can attract “new entrants” to join the green technology market and launch more green innovations. This paper further explores the significance of environmental regulation in narrowing the gap between green and non-green technologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境规制是否激励绿色技术创新在文献中存在争议。环境规制的潜在内生性是识别环境规制对绿色技术创新因果效应的主要实证挑战。为解决这一问题，我们利用中国总量控制政策的准自然实验作为环境规制的外生冲击。具体而言，我们构建了一个新的城市级减排任务数据集，并采用三重差分估计来探讨环境规制强度如何影响绿色技术创新。实证结果表明，环境规制促进了绿色创新。进一步的机制分析表明，环境规制可以吸引“新进入者”加入绿色技术市场并开展更多绿色创新。本文进一步探讨了环境规制在缩小绿色与非绿色技术差距方面的重要性。

articles.title_en: The relationship between willingness to pay and carbon footprint knowledge: Are individuals willing to pay more to offset their carbon footprint if they learn about its size and distance to the 1.5 °C target?
articles.title_cn: 支付意愿与碳足迹知识之间的关系：如果个人了解到其碳足迹规模及与1.5°C目标的差距，他们是否愿意支付更多来抵消碳足迹？
articles.abstract_en: We examine individuals' willingness to pay to offset their carbon footprint (WTPO) in response to receiving information about (i) their own carbon footprint size (size nudge), and (ii) receiving information about their own carbon footprint size and the gap with per-capita GHG emissions consistent with the 1.5 °C target (distance-to-target nudge). We employ a demographically representative online survey among the adult population in Germany which includes a carbon footprint calculator and the randomized information nudges. Results from estimating double-hurdle regression models suggest that the size nudge increases participants' average WTPO by about one third. Yet, we find only limited support that the distance-to-target nudge affects participants' WTPO. We further find that participants' response to the information nudge is primarily effective for younger participants, females, participants with mid-range income, with high levels of education, and with low to medium-sized carbon footprints, ceteris paribus. Further, the WTPO is positively related with income, education, carbon literacy, and environmental preferences. Also, participants tend to underestimate the size of their carbon footprint relative to that of others. We find no evidence, however, that participants' WTPO depends on whether they believe that their carbon footprint is lower or higher than that of others.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了个人在收到关于（i）自身碳足迹规模（规模助推）和（ii）自身碳足迹规模及与1.5°C目标一致的人均温室气体排放差距（目标距离助推）的信息后，支付意愿抵消其碳足迹（WTPO）的变化。我们在德国成年人口中开展了一项人口统计学代表性的在线调查，包括碳足迹计算器和随机信息助推。估计双障碍回归模型的结果表明，规模助推使参与者的平均WTPO增加了约三分之一。然而，我们发现目标距离助推对参与者WTPO的影响支持有限。我们还发现，在其他条件不变的情况下，信息助推对参与者WTPO的影响主要对年轻参与者、女性、中等收入参与者、高教育水平参与者以及碳足迹中低水平的参与者有效。此外，WTPO与收入、教育、碳素养和环境偏好正相关。同时，参与者倾向于低估自身碳足迹相对于他人的规模。然而，我们没有发现证据表明参与者的WTPO取决于他们是否认为自己的碳足迹低于或高于他人。

articles.title_en: Give and take: An analysis of the distributional consequences of emission tax-and-rebate schemes with an application to greenhouse gas emissions from European agriculture
articles.title_cn: 给予与索取：排放税与退税方案的分配后果分析——以欧洲农业温室气体排放为例
articles.abstract_en: The potential regressivity of an emission tax is a major obstacle to the implementation of this otherwise cost-effective instrument. Rebates may help overcome this difficulty. Their distributional consequences depend on their design and the distribution of agents’ initial emissions and abatement costs. We develop a stylized analytical framework to derive general conditions under which a tax-and-rebate scheme increases income inequality and compare the performances of various rebate designs. This framework is applied to the regulation of greenhouse gas emissions from European agriculture. An emission tax with no rebate is found to substantially reduce agricultural emissions (by approximately −15% for a 100 €/tCO2eq tax), but also strongly affect the total sector income (approximately −20% with the same tax rate) as well as increase income inequality. A flat rebate considerably reduces income inequality relative to pre-policy levels. For the same impacts on aggregate income and budget, a rebate proportional to initial emissions leaves pre-existing inequality virtually unchanged. A well-designed rebate can thus be critical for the acceptability of climate policy instruments.
articles.abstract_cn: 排放税可能具有累退性，这是实施这一本可成本有效的工具的主要障碍。退税可能有助于克服这一困难。其分配后果取决于退税设计以及主体初始排放和减排成本的分布。我们构建了一个简化的分析框架，以推导税收与退税方案增加收入不平等的一般条件，并比较各种退税设计的表现。该框架应用于欧洲农业温室气体排放的监管。研究发现，无退税的排放税可大幅减少农业排放（约−15%，对应100欧元/吨二氧化碳当量的税率），但也严重影响部门总收入（相同税率下约−20%），并加剧收入不平等。一次性退税相对于政策前水平显著降低了收入不平等。在对总收入和预算影响相同的情况下，按初始排放比例退税几乎不改变原有的不平等状况。因此，设计良好的退税对于气候政策工具的可接受性至关重要。
